high.title: Senior Software Engineer
high.description:
Job description - SSE

Location: Bangalore, India
 
The Role
 
We are looking for a skilled and motivated Senior Software Engineer to join our Cloud Services Software Development team at IGEL.
 
In this role, you will own and drive the full software lifecycle—from architecture and implementation to DevOps automation, production observability, and live incident analysis. You will work across our enterprise cloud applications and microservices, combining strong hands-on software engineering with AI engineering and DevOps practices.
 
We are looking for someone with deep hands-on experience in Node.js and React, a strong grasp of cloud-native and enterprise software architecture, and the ability to independently own complex technical deliverables. The ideal candidate brings sharp analytical and troubleshooting skills, collaborates effectively across teams, and raises the engineering bar through technical leadership and mentoring.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
- Design, drive, and maintain scalable, enterprise-grade web applications, RESTful APIs, and microservices using Node.js (Express.js) and React.js.
- Define and maintain stable, backward-compatible API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger) consumed by internal and external clients.
- Design, integrate, and optimize MongoDB data models, queries, and operational workflows.
- Implement and maintain secure authentication, authorization, and access-control flows (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT, RBAC), and proactively address security, CVE, and dependency hygiene.
- Own DevOps engineering practices for your services, including CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), Kubernetes/Helm deployments, configuration management, monitoring, and observability.
- Investigate and resolve escalated production and customer support cases, including hands-on root-cause analysis directly on Kubernetes (pods, logs, networking/ingress, resource metrics, and service health).
- Design and build AI-enabled features, workflows, and automation, and leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering velocity and software quality.
- Lead technical designs and architectural decisions across services, proactively identifying and resolving technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability risks.
- Take end-to-end ownership of complex features and services—from breaking down ambiguous requirements through development, automated testing, deployment, and post-release operation.
- Act as a technical subject-matter expert (SME) and collaborate across engineering, DevOps, product management, QA, and support teams to align interfaces and deliverables.
- Lead code reviews, uphold coding and testing standards, maintain clear technical documentation, and mentor less-experienced engineers.
 
Required Qualifications and Experience
 
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
- Minimum 6 years of professional software development experience in an enterprise software or cloud-native environment.
- Deep hands-on expertise in JavaScript and Node.js (preferably with Express.js), including asynchronous patterns, performance tuning, and security best practices.
- Strong hands-on experience in React.js building and maintaining production web applications.
- Hands-on experience with MongoDB in production environments (schema design, indexing, query optimization).
- Practical experience with authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT, RBAC).
- Strong DevOps engineering experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines, including hands-on troubleshooting and root-cause analysis directly in Kubernetes clusters.
- Experience investigating and resolving production incidents and customer support escalations.
- Hands-on experience in AI engineering (building or integrating AI/LLM-powered features, agents, or workflows) as well as using AI-assisted development tools in daily engineering work.
- Experience designing and evolving enterprise-grade APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger) and microservices with high standards for scalability, maintainability, performance, and reliability.
- Solid experience with Git and automated testing practices (unit and integration testing, e.g., Jest).
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to work independently, drive technical decisions, and mentor engineers in cross-functional teams.
 
Preferred Qualifications
 
- Experience working with Microsoft Azure (e.g., Azure Container Registry, Key Vault, AKS) and/or AWS.
- Experience with CDN/edge caching (e.g., Cloudflare Workers) and S3-compatible object storage (e.g., Cloudflare R2, AWS S3).
- Experience with TypeScript and React ecosystem technologies such as Redux and webpack.
- Experience with real-time or event-driven architectures (e.g., WebSockets/Socket.io, MongoDB Change Streams).
- Familiarity with Linux-based development and deployment environments.
- Experience with observability, logging, and monitoring stacks (e.g., structured logging, metrics, alerting).
- Experience working in Agile development environments and contributing to UI/UX improvements.
 
What We're Looking For
 
Beyond technical expertise, we value senior engineers who demonstrate:
 
- End-to-end ownership: Take full accountability from architecture and code through deployment, support, and production health.
- Technical leadership & autonomy: Navigate ambiguity, make sound architectural trade-offs, and drive solutions forward without constant supervision.
- Analytical troubleshooting: Apply structured reasoning to diagnose complex distributed-system and production issues quickly.
- Cross-team collaboration: Communicate technical decisions clearly and align effectively with engineering, product, QA, and support stakeholders.
- Mentoring & bar-raising mindset: Actively share knowledge, uplift peers through reviews and guidance, and strengthen team engineering practices.
- Innovation & continuous learning: Stay curious and pragmatic in adopting emerging technologies, including AI and modern DevOps practices.

How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

About The Role

As a Associate Software Development Engineer in Delta's Enterprise Payments team, you will be part of a team building secure, scalable, and reliable payment solutions that power Delta's digital commerce ecosystem. You will work alongside experienced engineers to develop backend services, APIs, and cloud-based applications while learning best practices in software engineering, security, and cloud technologies.

This role is ideal for early-career engineers who are passionate about software development, eager to learn modern technologies, and excited to solve real-world business problems at scale.

Key Responsibilities



- Develop and maintain backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.
- Build and consume REST APIs and support microservices-based applications.
- Assist in developing and deploying applications on AWS Cloud.
- Collaborate with product owners, architects, and senior engineers to deliver business solutions.
- Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality.
- Troubleshoot application issues and support production environments.
- Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and Agile development practices.
- Write unit tests and ensure code meets quality and security standards.
- Continuously learn and apply new technologies and engineering best practices.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)



- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
- 0-2 years of software development experience (including internships, academic projects, or full-time experience).
- Knowledge of Java programming fundamentals and object-oriented design.
- Understanding of Spring Boot, REST APIs, and basic microservices concepts.
- Familiarity with relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL.
- Exposure to source control systems such as Git.
- Basic understanding of cloud concepts; exposure to AWS is a plus.
- Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering fundamentals.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
- Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly and work effectively in a collaborative environment. 
- Demonstrated experience using AWS AI/ML services such as Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, and AgentCore through academic projects, internships, hackathons, or professional experience. 
- Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, Kiro, or similar platforms to generate code, review code, create test cases, develop documentation, and troubleshoot issues, while exercising sound judgment and validating AI-generated outputs. 
- Understanding of prompt engineering techniques, AI-assisted software development workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts, and model integration patterns for building intelligent applications.

Behavioral Competencies



- Ability to work in collaborative environments and embrace diverse perspectives. 
- Communicate clearly and concisely, express thoughts and ideas effectively, and embrace cultural differences with respect when engaging with others. 
- Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build strong partnerships. 
- Prioritize, maintain focus, and consistently deliver commitment. 
- Proactively understand customer expectations and willingness to create customer-based solutions

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)



- Internship or project experience in Java-based application development.
- Exposure to AWS services such as EC2, Lambda, API Gateway, or S3.
- Knowledge of React, Angular, JavaScript, HTML, or CSS.
- Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
- Understanding of Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
- Exposure to payment systems, e-commerce platforms, or financial applications is a plus.

About The Company

What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service.

Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good.

In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor’s 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience.

About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore

The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program. For more information, please visit www.deltatechhub.com

Why join? 



- Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience. 
- Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs –exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships. 
- Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture. 
- Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions. 
- Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme.
